column1: # Product image sources — canonical_name<TAB>page_url
# Read by `python -m scripts.seed_product_images --from-file`, which pulls the
# og:image from each page and uploads it to the product-images bucket. Run by
# hand, by the owner; nothing in the running platform reads this file.
# Why this file and not products.source_url: source_url means "the marketplace
# listing this product was submitted from" and feeds canonicalization. These
# are the manufacturers' own product pages -- the right place to read a product
# photo from, and the wrong answer to that question. Keeping them apart leaves
# both fields true.
# Each URL is the brand's official page for the exact product being reviewed.
# Verified resolvable on 2026-08-19 except where noted.
# The shop page shows the current-generation Air (and both sizes); this review
# is of the M2, so the WWDC22 announcement image is the one that is actually
# the product. Checked by eye, not just by status code.
Apple MacBook Air M2 (13-inch)
CeraVe Foaming Facial Cleanser
Anker 737 Power Bank (24000mAh)
Akko 5075B Plus Mechanical Keyboard
Jisulife Life9 Handheld Fan
# Uniqlo serves a bot challenge instead of the page on every path tried (US and
# PH, product and feature). It is listed so the intent is recorded and a future
# run picks it up if that ever changes; today it resolves to nothing and the
# product falls to the moderator upload path, exactly as the module docstring
# anticipates.
Uniqlo AIRism Crew Neck Tee
